description:
About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 

About the Team  

The Customer Advocacy team you would lead is part of the broader Corporate Marketing team, which is focused on driving awareness, credibility, and presence among customers, prospects, partners, analysts, and influencers. This dynamic team is comprised of many functions, including communications, customer advocacy, and analyst relations. We serve different roles, but we all work together to amplify the Outreach brand. 

The Role 

At Outreach, our customers are our best advocates and most important asset. Do you love getting to know customers, what matters to them, and creating impactful programs that amplify their voice? We're looking for a dynamic Customer Advocacy Manager to join our corporate marketing team and drive advocacy throughout our customer base. 

This is a high-impact, highly cross-functional role where you'll blend creative storytelling, relationship building, and strategic program design to drive measurable business outcomes. In this role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of our customer advocacy and reference program. Partnering with sales, marketing, customer success, and product teams, you will identify, curate, and amplify impactful customer experiences that elevate both our customers and our brand. 

AI is changing how customer stories get found, shaped, and shared, and this role sits right at that intersection. We're a marketing team that uses AI to match the right advocate to the right moment, turn customer conversations into publishable stories faster, and spend more of our time on the relationships that make advocacy work. We're looking for someone who brings that same instinct to the program. 

 
Location: We’re open to remote within the US or hybrid at one of our office locations (Seattle, Atlanta).

lists.content:
• Run Daily Advocacy Operations: Own the day-to-day operations of the advocacy and reference program, including intake, prioritization, approvals, scheduling, and fulfillment. 
  • Maintain the System of Record: Keep customer profiles, permissions, and engagement history accurate and current within the reference management system. 
  • Produce Customer Stories: Work directly with customers to capture their success stories and translate them into compelling assets, including case studies, blogs, videos, testimonials, podcasts, webinars, and speaking engagements. 
  • Curate the Asset Library: Maintain a centralized, searchable repository of advocacy and reference assets for Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success. 
  • Support Sales and Customer Success: Match Sales and Customer Success teams with relevant customer advocates for RFPs, references, and deal support. 
  • Measure and Report on Impact: Track advocacy activity and support measurement of the program's impact on sales acceleration, customer engagement, and brand awareness. 
  • Strengthen the Program: Proactively identify and solve challenges in advocate recruitment, program participation, and content development.

As you step into this role, you bring with you a sense of enthusiasm and purpose, ready to make a meaningful impact on our organization and the customers we serve. You're eager to immerse yourself in our dynamic environment, where creativity and collaboration are not just encouraged but celebrated as essential drivers of innovation. 

  • 5+ years of experience in customer marketing, advocacy, or references within a B2B technology environment 

  • Proven experience supporting sales reference and customer advocacy programs 

  • Background in B2B customer marketing, advocacy, or reference programs 

  • Exceptional written, verbal, high attention to detail and strong presentation skills 

  • Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to align advocacy programs with business priorities and drive measurable impact 

  • Solid understanding of B2B marketing fundamentals and how customer stories drive trust and pipeline 

  • Customer-first mindset with the ability to understand customer goals, pain points, and sentiment 

  • Demonstrated curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, with a track record of using them to streamline program operations and free up time for higher-value customer relationships. 

  • Preferred skills: Tech savvy with experience utilizing AI and sales reference management tools to streamline, automate, and optimize customer advocacy processes for increased efficiency and impact.

additional:
#LI-AM1

Why You’ll Love It Here
 
• Flexible time off
• 401k to help you save for the future
• Generous medical, dental, and vision coverage for full-time employees and their dependents
• A parental leave program that includes options for a paid night nurse, and a gradual return to work
• Infertility/ assisted reproductive services benefit
• Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
• Snacks and beverages in the Office, along with fun events to celebrate
• Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like Outreach Women's Network, Latinx community, Outreach Black Connection, AAPI community, Pride/LGBTQIA+, Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
 
Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few. 

The Team 

Outreach is the agentic revenue platform built for modern go-to-market teams. We help revenue organizations run their entire sales motion, from first touch to closed deal to post sales, inside a single platform that goes beyond insights and delivers actions to sellers to move deals and revenue forward. 

Conversation, voice, and meeting intelligence sit at the center of that motion. Every customer conversation generates signal. Outreach captures that signal and turns it into action: real-time coaching for reps, automatic follow-ups, and the deal and pipeline intelligence leaders need to know where to focus, what to fix, and how to improve. Reps close more. Leaders lead better. The conversation is where it starts. 

The Role 

This leader will own product strategy and execution across conversation intelligence, voice, meeting intelligence, and dialing. The mission is to transform every customer conversation into agentic action: coaching reps in the moment, accelerating deals, and giving leaders a clear, data-driven view of where to invest their time and how to improve their team performance and sales strategy. 

This role sits at the intersection of AI and data, voice and video, to deliver real-time coaching and actions. It requires a sharp point of view on both seller and sales leadership personas, and a track record of building product that changes how teams work, not just how they report.

lists.content:
• Define and own the product strategy for meeting intelligence, conversation intelligence, voice, and dialing 

  • Deliver AI-native experiences and workflows, building on the latest model and technology advancements 

  • Ship AI and ML features with world-class engineering, data science, and design teams that turn conversations into agentic actions 

  • Lead discovery and roadmap sessions with key prospects and customers 

  • Lead and develop a team of accomplished product managers, driving strategy across multiple scrum teams, enabling high performance, and championing strong processes and best practices 

  • Partner with product marketing to build enablement and positioning, thought leadership on agentic execution for go-to-market teams 

  • Build deep understanding of customer feedback and product stickiness to inform prioritization and long-term bets

• 8+ years building great software with ownership of prioritization, trade-offs, and timelines; 2+ years managing product teams 

  • Experience building conversation intelligence, voice, or dialing products preferred, including familiarity with VoIP and telephony infrastructure, speech-to-text and NLP pipelines, real-time audio and video processing 

  • Proven ability to define long-term strategy while driving near-term product impact in fast-paced, entrepreneurial environments 

  • Deep understanding of customer needs with strong drive to solve hard problems and demonstrated technical credibility with engineering teams 

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration, influence, and communication skills with the ability to create clarity in complex, ambiguous domains 

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA or related graduate degree preferred 

  • Prior B2B SaaS product experience
